messages.subject: MENA Executive Profile | Mining, ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Aston Associates / IMSA Middle East Team,

Your executive-search work across Africa and the Middle East, including senior industrial and construction appointments, aligns closely with my international profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates across mining, energy, infrastructure and major industrial investment. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
